scripts.dev: bun run build:wasm && bun node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js dev
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.deploy:dev: bun run build:wasm && RECALL_STATE=cloudflare bun node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js deploy --stage dev --yes --no-input
scripts.deploy:production: bun run build:wasm && RECALL_STATE=cloudflare bun node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js deploy --stage production --yes --no-input
